items.title: USA TODAY Sports Launches New Fantasy Platform - USA TODAY Co.
items.summary: Expert Insights and Enhanced Tools for Fantasy Football Managers USA TODAY Sports, part of USA TODAY Co., Inc. (NYSE: TDAY), has launched USA TODAY Sports Fantasy, a new fantasy subscription platform that combines expert insights, advanced projections and decision-support tools to help fantasy managers make smarter roster and lineup decisions throughout the NFL season. Seamlessly integrated into the broader USA TODAY Sports ecosystem, the platform is designed for both casual and experienced fantasy players. Available across web and mobile, USA TODAY Sports Fantasy delivers the insights and resources managers need to stay competitive every week of the football season. Subscribers gain access to a comprehensive suite of fantasy tools, including: League Sync: Connect your league to receive personalized matchup odds, optimized lineup recommendations and waiver wire pickups tailored to your roster. Rankings & Projections: Access expert rankings, advanced player projections and detailed statistical breakdowns to inform key roster decisions. items.title: USA TODAY Entertainment Expands Team - USA TODAY Co.
items.summary: USA TODAY welcomes new editorial leaders and reporters across entertainment, culture, style, beauty and new media to further expand entertainment coverage. These additions reflect USA TODAY’s continued investment in premium entertainment, lifestyle and culture journalism, while expanding coverage of the topics and personalities shaping today’s media landscape. Charlie Carballo joins as West Coast Editor, based in Los Angeles. Most recently Executive Digital Director at Women’s Wear Daily, Carballo brings extensive experience overseeing breaking news coverage, audience development, SEO and analytics. Morgan Evans joins as Style & Beauty Reporter. Based in New York, Evans has contributed to publications including Vogue and InStyle and has covered many of the industry’s most prominent fashion and entertainment events. Zachary Pincus-Roth joins as New Media Editor, where he will oversee coverage of internet culture, content creators, influencers and emerging digital platforms. Based in Washington, D.C., Pincus-Roth most recently served as Senior Editor in The Washington Post’s Style section. Kalia Richardson joins as Entertainment Reporter covering documentaries and nostalgia. items.title: USA TODAY PLAY Expands Digital Comics Library with Marvel Comics - USA TODAY Co.
items.summary: Includes all-new Marvel Infinity Comics series and access to expansive digital catalog of comics USA TODAY PLAY, a unified digital hub for casual entertainment and gaming, part of USA TODAY Co., Inc. (NYSE: TDAY), announced a collaboration with Marvel Comics to provide an exclusive vertically-formatted Marvel Infinity “Spider-Man TODAY” Comic series to USA TODAY PLAY. The all-new specially created comic “Spider-Man TODAY” weekly subscriber series written by Al Ewing and illustrated by Todd Nauck will publish every Wednesday for the next 47 weeks showcasing the adventures of the web-slinger teaming up with heroes from across the Marvel Universe. Additionally, USA TODAY PLAY subscribers can enjoy unlimited access to a catalog of 1,000 digital comics from Marvel’s expansive breadth of characters and storylines including X-Men, Captain America, Black Panther, Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy, and Captain Marvel among many others. *Non-subscribers can explore a curated weekly selection. “We’re thrilled to expand the USA TODAY PLAY brand through this exciting collaboration with Marvel,” said Dara Sanderson, Vice President and General Manager of...

items.title: USA TODAY Great American Tailgate Announced - USA TODAY Co.
items.summary: Partnership with the Pro Football Hall of Fame celebrates food and fandom USA TODAY NETWORK Ventures, the events division of USA TODAY Co., Inc. (NYSE: TDAY) announced the USA TODAY Great American Tailgate, an inaugural event that brings fans together for an epic culinary celebration in the spirit of football. In partnership with Pro Football Hall of Fame, the festivities will take place during football’s biggest celebration weekend from August 5-9 in Canton, Ohio. USA TODAY Great American Tailgate is a standalone experience within Sugardale Fan Fest, a five-day event taking over the Pro Football Hall of Fame campus. The ticketed tailgate experience offers fans a one‑of‑a‑kind opportunity to enjoy iconic foods inspired by all 32 Pro Football teams, bringing the flavors and traditions of their respective home markets together in a nationwide tailgate celebration. From Maryland crab cakes and New York bagels to Philadelphia cheesesteaks and New Orleans jambalaya, this tailgate will unite football fans with a smorgasbord of food and festivities. “We’re incredibly excited to launch the inaugural USA TODAY Great American Tailgate and bring fans together to enjoy everything that makes football culture so special,” said Jason Taylor, USA TODAY Co.
